ashestith.name: Ashestith
ashestith.notes: A scorched ash-world of martial citadels, drowned glass cities and frozen steppes, its sky stained with fallen ash.

grimukougok.name: Grimukougok
grimukougok.notes: A frost-bound Martial Realm of humming basalt terraces, walled fortress-towns and root-groves, rendered in cold grey-blue light with ash-tinted hot spots near the sundered shards.

groktok.name: Groktok
groktok.notes: Frost-soil realm of ash-grey skies, scarred cliffs and drowned moorland, tiled from the Groktok entries.

joradernath.name: Joradernath
joradernath.notes: A frost-bitten Martial realm of scarred battlefields and ice peaks, softened by warm coastal and jungle pockets where the machine-war left its ruins.

keludoren.name: Keludoren
keludoren.notes: A frost-soiled martial world of ash-grey skies and dueling cities, where snowfields give way to windswept basalt ridges and a dry, sun-scorched desert at the warm edge.

khairnar.name: Khairnar
khairnar.notes: A martial, ash-scoured world of fortified basalt terraces, sundered shards and ember-lakes, its cold highlands giving way to dry lowlands and a few sheltered groves.

khogar.name: Khogar
khogar.notes: Khogar's Martial Realm is a land of walled cities, sieges, and silver-humming roots, rendered here in cold stone light, ash-tinged fog, and the lingering glow of ancient wards.

kraizhoth.name: Kraizhoth
kraizhoth.notes: A frost-bound martial realm of sunken vaults, iron steppes and drowned halls, shaded in cold blues and bronze.

losaustanum.name: Losaustanum
losaustanum.notes: A frost-bound world of cold northern tribes, sheltered coasts and harsh southern plains, where wind, snow and hard-fought rule shape the land.

orintanum.name: Orintanum
orintanum.notes: A frost-bound northern realm of cold coasts and scattered peninsulas, with plains and taiga bordering a heated badland and swamp reaching toward a green-tinged horizon.

suranareno.name: Suranareno
suranareno.notes: A wind-scoured martial world of ash-hazed basalt ridges, sunlit terraces and tide-worn coasts, where the Weave's dormant roots and training halls shape the land.

breraston.name: Breraston
breraston.notes: Breraston's frozen, martial realm tiles from cold windswept peaks and snowfields through lush meadows and forests to arid plains, a shadowed desert settlement, and a murky swamp.

tarnesten.name: Tarnesten
tarnesten.notes: A soot-dimmed martial world of ash-choked badlands, iron-grey peaks, and fortress-coast waters, with cold highlands and swamps at its edges.

torarnak.name: Torarnak
torarnak.notes: A sunless, ash-choked underworld of basalt highlands, fungal hollows and glowing lava seas, where fortress-cities and iron-forges cling to grim, war-scarred terrain.

torugun.name: Torugun
torugun.notes: Torugun's surface cycles from scorched glass deserts and ash-veined badlands through jungle and swamp to frost-bound glacial peaks, under a perpetually ash-veiled sky over a lava sea.

torukouthar.name: Torukouthar
torukouthar.notes: A martial-realm world of frost-hued valleys, humming basalt, and ash-glass shrines, where the Singing, Seeding, and Sundering left scarred ridges, fortress-cities, and ashen skies.

vhaikun.name: Vhaikun
vhaikun.notes: A frost-bitten martial realm of frozen moons, sunken fortresses and scorched rifts, its mood shifting from bleak snowfields to dark, humid woodland and ash-dry badlands.

vhoggaktak.name: Vhoggaktak
vhoggaktak.notes: A martial, ash-choked world of sunken fortresses and iron citadels, its scorched deserts and frost-scoured northern steppe rising into bronze-lit skies.

vorairnok.name: Vorairnok
vorairnok.notes: A dim, ash-grey martial world of scorched badlands, glassy deserts and drowned reefs, lit by cold skies and sheltered by frost-bitten peaks.

crede.name: Crede
crede.notes: A frost-bound martial world whose cold northern ranges give way to sunlit river-cities and dry, ash-touched plains.

crurnon.name: Crurnon
crurnon.notes: Crurnon's frozen northern tundra gives way to amber badlands, desert basins and smoky gearworks valleys, with a fair meadow and sunlit plains threading the middle of the world.

draggouzhok.name: Draggouzhok
draggouzhok.notes: Ash-dark, ember-lit valleys and basalt terraces ring a glowing lava sea, with rare rain falling on the sheltered groves and meadows of the Weave.

draktak.name: Draktak
draktak.notes: A frost-bitten martial world whose sunken basalt cities hum with old resonance, its cold steel skies sheltering scorched badlands and root-haunted groves.

drathouggun.name: Drathouggun
drathouggun.notes: A martial ash-veiled world of terraced fortress valleys, basalt reefs and glass-river gorges, shaped by the Singing and the Sundering.

drorkaigok.name: Drorkaigok
drorkaigok.notes: A martial world of ash, basalt and lava, where forges and war-engines have left scarred plains, sunken glass basins and fungal marshes beneath a boiling, cold-tinged sky.

gouthun.name: Gouthun
gouthun.notes: A frost-bound Martial world whose walled terraces, bronze-bell courts and hearth-lit monasteries sit among cold stone, silent sunken valleys and sheltering groves.

brurnadeld.name: Brurnadeld
brurnadeld.notes: A volcanic, ember-lit world of dusky skies and ash-fall, with arid badlands and deserts giving way to humid coasts and wooded highlands.

osulaltanum.name: Osulaltanum
osulaltanum.notes: A cinder-choked world of ash winds, ember-lit badlands and smouldering swamps drawn from the Ki realm's sunken forges, dead cities and ash-grey pillars.

osutaala.name: Osutaala
osutaala.notes: A dim ember-lit realm of ash skies and resonant stone, where bronze waters, reed canals and terraced grove-cities give way to cold black-glass peaks at the edge of the Ki world.

osuvaeno.name: Osuvaeno
osuvaeno.notes: A scorched ember-realm of basalt terraces, sealed heat and drifting ash, where the lava seas and glass-black hills hold the scars of the Sundering.

tianausanum.name: Tianausanum
tianausanum.notes: A dim ember-lit world of drowned bell-cities, glass archipelagos, and sunless hollows, with stone peaks, ash-veiled deserts, and tidal swamps sitting under a perpetually dusky sky.

tirakaluta.name: Tirakaluta
tirakaluta.notes: A sundered, ember-lit world of ash-drifted shard basins, glass cisterns and sealed vault-cities, its skies bruised violet over salt seas and luminous fungal deeps.

ukaraeno.name: Ukaraeno
ukaraeno.notes: Ember-soil highlands of rain, lakes and warm mist give way to dune and volcanic-ember deserts, with frigid glass-ice peaks at the cold edge.

venuala.name: Venuala
venuala.notes: Venuala's ash-lit skies, violet seas and glass-spired highlands are drawn from its resonant, drowned and crystalline places, with the Ki realm's sunlit groves and frozen basins framing the range.

coreoserus.name: Coreoserus
coreoserus.notes: A realm of sundered shards and humming stone, where cold peaks, scorched basins, and drowned citadels sit beside groves of living light and courts of old war.

grimozhun.name: Grimozhun
grimozhun.notes: A dim ash-choked realm of drowned cathedrals and basalt terraces, its badlands, swamps and frozen peaks tinted by ember light, tides and bell-song.

grorkaigoth.name: Grorkaigoth
grorkaigoth.notes: A sunless ember-lit realm of basalt, ash, and singing stone, with marsh, badland, and thorn-forest terrain shaped by the Sundering and the Singing.

kaluvamoma.name: Kaluvamoma
kaluvamoma.notes: Ember soil and the Ki realm's sunlit and tidal moods shape a world of ice fields and salt-glass shores, ember-lit highlands, and violet-storm marshes.

krogok.name: Krogok
krogok.notes: A scorched world of ash-storms, basalt highlands, salt flats and sheltered groves, its seas replaced by molten lava.

lyanae.name: Lyanae
lyanae.notes: A sun-scorched Ki realm of desert salt basins and glass-dune frontiers gives way to humid mangrove lagoons and cold, sea-battered highlands, all under a blue sky tinged with ember-coloured haze.

lyarae.name: Lyarae
lyarae.notes: A dusky ash-tinged world of glass spires, hollow basins, and sunken shrines, with mournful pale-blue lakes and copper-tinged fungal flats.

oriinnys.name: Oriinnys
oriinnys.notes: A dusk-violet world of drifting glass archipelagos, scarred Sundering badlands and tidal memory-swamps under a sky of ash and star-light.

alaenneirae.name: Alaenneirae
alaenneirae.notes: A ash-dark arcane world of fractured basalt highlands, humming glass-green basins, and luminous fungal groves where cloud-spires and storms drift over a salt-remembering sea.

eliolerae.name: Eliolerae
eliolerae.notes: Shifting ash-lit skies and drifting glass isles over slow, luminous seas give this arcane world a dreamlike, reverent character.

eluannys.name: Eluannys
eluannys.notes: Eluannys is a violet arcane realm of floating crystal archipelagos, drowned highlands and sky-cities, lit by moonlight and tidal mist.

ilyenna.name: Ilyenna
ilyenna.notes: A violet-skied world of crystal wastes, frost-bitten peaks, and ash-dusted badlands, where ancient ruins and dark lakes shape the land.

ilyimeth.name: Ilyimeth
ilyimeth.notes: A violet-lit Arcane realm of glass-green lagoons, lantern-haunted groves and drowned cathedrals, with ash drifting over the mists.

krarnaizhok.name: Krarnaizhok
krarnaizhok.notes: A violet-lit world of silver groves, black basalt courts and drowned glass citadels, where ash drifts from the old fires and the sea holds the sworn echoes of the Pact.

lyannae.name: Lyannae
lyannae.notes: A violet-tinted arcane realm of drifting archipelagos, humming basins, drowned sanctuaries and ash-wracked peaks, under a low sky with silver mist.

lyannora.name: Lyannora
lyannora.notes: A violet-lit Arcane world of humming basalt and glass, where cold resonant peaks give way to ash-hazed shrine valleys, rose-lit groves and quiet grey marshes.

lyariel.name: Lyariel
lyariel.notes: A violet-tinted world of drowned archives, silver mist and floating spires, where ash drifts over ancient ruins and the sea hums with stored sorcery.

lyemwen.name: Lyemwen
lyemwen.notes: A violet-ashed world of sunken cathedrals, singing stone and drifting futures, where lava seas cool beneath an ash-choked sky.

lyenora.name: Lyenora
lyenora.notes: A dreaming, arcane world of verdant woods, stony highlands, and sun-scorched wastes bound by ridges and rivers of enchantment.

alaima.name: Alaima
alaima.notes: A violet-skied arcane world where shifting terraces, drowned sanctums and ash-choked fortresses share one tiled landscape under humming, luminous air.

lyirlora.name: Lyirlora
lyirlora.notes: A violet arcane world of ash-glass deserts, hummingly luminous seas, crystal spires, and drifting mists beneath a perpetual ash-tinged sky.

miana.name: Miana
miana.notes: A luminous, storm-lit world of frozen peaks, drowned swamps and glass-hued sanctuaries, its skies shifting between violet dusk and starlight.

miarlinnys.name: Miarlinnys
miarlinnys.notes: Miarlinnys is a realm of ash-hazed skies, sleeping arcane stone, and reed-lined rivers humming with stored sorcery, ranging from glassy swamps and sunken marshes to violet basalt peaks and frozen crags.

mieneth.name: Mieneth
mieneth.notes: A violet-lit realm of humming stone and shelved futures, where ash drifts over basalt terraces, gloomy lakes mirror a sky that never clears, and violet groves bloom among the ruins of the Sundering.

mienys.name: Mienys
mienys.notes: A mist-hung arcane world of humming roots, glass cisterns and sung valleys, sheltered groves and basalt courts, with hushed greys and violet light throughout.

miilora.name: Miilora
miilora.notes: A realm of frost-glass peaks, ash-dark sinks, and sun-scorched sultanates, with rivers that carry the sediment of dead worlds.

miimeth.name: Miimeth
miimeth.notes: A violet, ember-lit world of drowned citadels, glowing hearths and singing groves, its skies streaked with drifting ash over a tidal sea that seems to remember every oath.

miinnora.name: Miinnora
miinnora.notes: Silver-hummed groves, ash-veined highlands and drowned glass cities give Miinnora an arcane, melancholic surface of violet skies and muted greens.

nualireth.name: Nualireth
nualireth.notes: Basalt terraces, singing stone, and fissures that breathe light give Nualireth violet skies, ash drifting from the Sundering, and a quiet, resonant mix of badlands, mushroom fields and frozen peaks.

nuemiel.name: Nuemiel
nuemiel.notes: A realm of hums, sundered shards, and glass-black basins under a violet twilight sky, where Arcane ruins and floating archives mark each era.

alaimeinora.name: Alaimeinora
alaimeinora.notes: A tangled, wayward wilderness of sealed gates, sunlit shores and drifting sanctums, with mirror-bright fields giving way to a quiet, misty sea.

nueriel.name: Nueriel
nueriel.notes: A soaked, storm-lit world of luminous arcane sanctums and drowned cities, bordered by ash-scarred badlands and frozen highlands.

nuileiniel.name: Nuileiniel
nuileiniel.notes: A violet-skied archipelago world of crystal spires, sunken cities and drifting mist, where ash drifts over its arcane ridges and the seas glow with stored starlight.

nuilleimwen.name: Nuilleimwen
nuilleimwen.notes: A resonant, ash-stirred world of humming basalt, glass-walled cloisters and silver orchards under a violet sky, with its sunken vaults and tide-gates echoing the Sundering.

nuimiel.name: Nuimiel
nuimiel.notes: Silver-violet skies and hovering ash over a world of hum-tuned groves, glass orchards, and sunken basalt courts.

oriamora.name: Oriamora
oriamora.notes: Oriamora's surface blends ash-dusted basalt savannas and glass badlands with lantern-lit wetlands and violet-skied cherry groves, under a sky tinged by the Arcane Realm's drifting fog and sundered wards.

oriellys.name: Oriellys
oriellys.notes: Violet-lit terraces and ash-glass shrines under drifting lanterns, with sunken violet seas where the Library's shelved futures bleed into the water.

orienna.name: Orienna
orienna.notes: Silver-rooted valleys, sunken cathedral-cities and drowned glass citadels of Orienna are rendered as violet-lit terraces under drifting ash, with a deep sea holding the Sundering's ruins.

orierlae.name: Orierlae
orierlae.notes: A luminous, mild-to-harsh world of arcane deserts, marshes and icy highlands framed by warm sea islands and hidden waterways, drawn from the supplied entries.

oriilora.name: Oriilora
oriilora.notes: A violet-lit arcane world of drowned cities, glass isles and humming stone, where mist, ash and shifting skies give way to frozen peaks and rose-hued terraces.

ryala.name: Ryala
ryala.notes: A violet-lit arcane realm of glass deserts, crystal reefs and hovering sanctums, with a moon-tinged sky, drifting ash, and mist-touched marshes spanning cold peaks to hot basins.

alainiel.name: Alainiel
alainiel.notes: A surface of storm-smeared plains, ash-bright badlands, mirror-lake swamps and glass-blue deeps, drawn from the Arcane realm's dreams, memories and ruin.

ryamiel.name: Ryamiel
ryamiel.notes: A violet-lit world of singing stone, drifting archives and ember-moss valleys, where lava seas and ash fall beneath silver-clouded skies.

ryanirae.name: Ryanirae
ryanirae.notes: A violet twilight world of glass islands, ember-lit temple cities and humming stone basins, shaped by the ash-fall of the Sundering and the drowned shoreline of the Shards.

ryellae.name: Ryellae
ryellae.notes: A violet-lit arcane world of drowned cities, luminous moss and singing glass, where ash-touched skies drift above fog-bound valleys, desert vaults and frozen calderas.

ryelora.name: Ryelora
ryelora.notes: A dreamlit, mana-charged world of glasshouses, drowned vaults and violet ash, with its sunless hollows and silver waters rendered in cool moody tones.

ryenaerlae.name: Ryenaerlae
ryenaerlae.notes: A twilight Arcane world of silver stone, humming roots and glass islets, its soil of Bloom glowing faintly beneath an ash-streaked violet sky.

ryeralwen.name: Ryeralwen
ryeralwen.notes: A humming, silver-violet world of resonant valleys, glass-black ridges and walled harbors, with ash drifting over the dry dunes and sorrowful hollows.

ryerlae.name: Ryerlae
ryerlae.notes: A drowned arcane world of glass, mist and sunken archives, with ash-laden skies and luminous tides.

ryira.name: Ryira
ryira.notes: Ash-veiled arcane realm of violet mists, crystal spires, and luminous tidal glyphs, spread across desert, marsh, highland and drowned coast.

ryirleth.name: Ryirleth
ryirleth.notes: A violet-lit world of broken light: drowned cathedral-cities and glass-green valleys give way to silver groves, ash-dusted stone basins, and cold frozen peaks beneath a sky tinged by the Shards.

silaeramys.name: Silaeramys
silaeramys.notes: A violet-hued Arcane surface of frost plains, ember-tinted woodlands and crystal-bright highlands, with a hushed shoreline of pale glass isles and sunlit golden fields under a dusky sky.

elaelys.name: Elaelys
elaelys.notes: Ashen-violet skies and lantern-lit arcane hues tie the biomes together, from frost-bound northern peaks and salt-glass shores to the dry, glass-black basins of the Sundering.

silanneth.name: Silanneth
silanneth.notes: A pale arcane world of humming basalt, glass-blue citadels and drowned archives, where cool crystalline meadows give way to misty wet groves and sunken libraries.

silara.name: Silara
silara.notes: Silara's ashen, arcane-humming surface moves from the mist-hung grove-cities and sunken brine-glass citadels through hot violet ridgelands toward the mangrove marshes and the ash-darkened sea.

silemuarora.name: Silemuarora
silemuarora.notes: A silent lavender-violet realm of resonant stone, silver groves and glass-black basins, humming under a pale violet sky.

silena.name: Silena
silena.notes: Silena's surface blends violet glass-marsh, ashen dusk-hills and drowned crystal seas under a perpetually twilight sky, with the desert and frozen wastes marking its drained and sealed extremes.

silenioriel.name: Silenioriel
silenioriel.notes: A dim violet realm of drifting ash, glass salt flats, sunken vault-cities and frozen starlight seas, where the arcane hums beneath every shore.

siliomaerae.name: Siliomaerae
siliomaerae.notes: A silver-tided arcane world of sunken glass cities, drowned archipelagos and singing waters, with dry ash-scarred badlands and frosted highlands at its edges.

siliorlora.name: Siliorlora
siliorlora.notes: A twilight arcane world of glass terraces, hovering archipelagos and humming lattices, where the sky carries a violet glow and ashen drift.

siluanae.name: Siluanae
siluanae.notes: A pale-skied arcane realm of scorched plateaus, bone-strewn vaults, fungal fens and frost ravines, tiled from the supplied entries with ashfall drifting over it.

siluanora.name: Siluanora
siluanora.notes: Violet-dusk Arcane skies over glass-blue tides and a drowsy, memory-soaked interior tiling from frozen peaks to dry badlands.

venaemeth.name: Venaemeth
venaemeth.notes: Venaemeth's surface is a patchwork of arcane frost-lands, ash-scoured basins, drowned mist-marshes and silver-misted meadows under a violet, ash-laden sky.

elaennirlys.name: Elaennirlys
elaennirlys.notes: A realm of forest, highland and desert contrasts, lit by soft wind-carried light where ancient shrines and buried ruins lie beneath quiet hills.

venaremwen.name: Venaremwen
venaremwen.notes: A violet arcane world of sundered citadels, humming glass basins, and hushed wards, where ash drifts rarely over badlands and mushroom fields while shadowed mires and frosted spires hold the edges of its doors between worlds.

venarirleth.name: Venarirleth
venarirleth.notes: A dim violet-lit world of drowned glass and salt marsh, where swamp, jungle and frozen highlands are spread across the cold-to-hot range under a perpetual arcane haze.

veneiluana.name: Veneiluana
veneiluana.notes: A silver-lit grove world of sunken citadels and glass shards, where the cold blue deep and the humming stone set a quiet, sorcerous mood.

veneruamora.name: Veneruamora
veneruamora.notes: A violet-twilight world of silver rivers and ash-drifting wastelands, where frozen peaks and drowned swamps frame the scorched desert and badlands of the east.

venileth.name: Venileth
venileth.notes: A violet-lit world of drowned cathedrals, ash-dusted badlands and singing stone, where the sea holds the fractured light of the Sundering.

venilleth.name: Venilleth
venilleth.notes: Venilleth's surface moves from luminous hill-courts and cherry groves through mirrored seas and misted swamps to cold, cloud-wrapped peaks, all lit by a pale arcane sky.

veniolora.name: Veniolora
veniolora.notes: A humming arcane world of drifting shards and bell-stone valleys, where lilac skies, violet mists and resonant waters mark the lands shaped by the Sundering and the Singing.

venualys.name: Venualys
venualys.notes: A pale, humming arcane realm of frost-bound plains, glass spires and still silver lakes, with warmer salt marshes along the coast.

elamirla.name: Elamirla
elamirla.notes: A violet-lit realm of humming stone, drifting glass and ash-scattered plains, where bells, flame and ringing walls tint every biome with mauve and silver.

eleirenora.name: Eleirenora
eleirenora.notes: A violet, ash-drifting arcane world where cherry groves, meadows and flower forests drift between glowing crystalline frozen peaks, molten badlands and drowned swamps.

eleniel.name: Eleniel
eleniel.notes: A realm of black glass, singing stone and old fire, its terraces and wardstones tinted in muted violet, ash-grey and pale luminous green.

ashiazis.name: Ashiazis
ashiazis.notes: A dusky violet sky over a basalt-and-ember world where ash drifts from cooling stone, the crystalline spires and ion-lit dust of Ashiazis tinting its meadows, badlands and lava seas in muted, luminous hues.

shyuthora.name: Shyuthora
shyuthora.notes: A dim, ash-dusted world of frozen canyons and scorched basins, where salt-pale deserts meet murky green swamps under a steel-blue sky.

syezeth.name: Syezeth
syezeth.notes: Syezeth's surface runs from singing frozen peaks and mirror-glass ice basins in the cold, through misty glass-island forests and cherry groves, to sunlit savannas and a red sun-scorched badlands in the heat, with the sea kept under a cold d

syuzeth.name: Syuzeth
syuzeth.notes: A scorched, ash-choked realm of glassfire ridges, dune seas, and fog-drowned coral valleys, ending in frozen glacial basins at the cold edge.

tarnaldath.name: Tarnaldath
tarnaldath.notes: A dim, ash-tinted realm of stellar dust where scorched deserts and badlands give way to frozen peaks, dark woods and violet seas beneath a lantern-lit sky.

tarnordath.name: Tarnordath
tarnordath.notes: A stellar iron world of ash-grey skies where ruined stone, reeds and frozen wastes mark the scattered traces of ancient courts and wars.

theivsis.name: Theivsis
theivsis.notes: The planet is a scorched iron world of glass canyons, ember terraces and ash-choked basins, where the dying red light gives way to pale frozen plains and grey stony peaks.

thivsora.name: Thivsora
thivsora.notes: A glowing, ash-choked world whose oceans, deserts, frozen peaks and fungal forests reflect the mixed stellar moods of its entries.

vesathora.name: Vesathora
vesathora.notes: Ash-hazed violet skies over a world of mourning groves, sundered badlands and frozen crystal peaks, with cherry and mushroom groves glowing like sanctuaries among the wreckage.

vesiathith.name: Vesiathith
vesiathith.notes: A volcanic iron-crusted world of ash-choked badlands, scorched deserts, and storm-lashed swamps, with a glowing lava sea and frozen crystal peaks at the cold edge.

vesizathith.name: Vesizathith
vesizathith.notes: A dim, ash-drifting world of dry desert basins, cold stone peaks and humid swamp lowlands under a violet-tinged sky, with its sea a deep grey-blue.

drerdunen.name: Drerdunen
drerdunen.notes: Iron-soiled Drerdunen is a stellar realm of ash-hung plains, rust-red badlands, and cold grey peaks, with its quiet coasts and mushroom-choked valleys drifting between sheltered warmth and bitter frost.

vesizora.name: Vesizora
vesizora.notes: The ashen, resonant skies of Vesizora shape a tiled surface of cold glass ridges, scorched badlands and humming forests, drawn from the Singing, Sundering and Holy Age entries.

xaasseth.name: Xaasseth
xaasseth.notes: A sun-scorched, mostly dry world of glassy reef-islands, resin-cathedral dunes and crystal-humming frontiers, with lush shelters at its wetter, stranger edges.

zepheistith.name: Zepheistith
zepheistith.notes: A dim, ash-tinged stellar world of violet skies and glassy frontiers, where frozen peaks and desert basins meet luminous mushroom fields and drowned swamps.

zepheivseth.name: Zepheivseth
zepheivseth.notes: A violet-skied world of basalt plains, glass-blue seas and frozen aurora-glass highlands, ringed by ash-wracked badlands and sulfur-scented swamps.

zephessith.name: Zephessith
zephessith.notes: A dim, starlit world of crystal lattices and orbital foundries, its surfaces tinged with violet dusk, gold stellar light and ash drifting from the sky.

zephivsora.name: Zephivsora
zephivsora.notes: A dim, ash-drifted realm of ruined glass spires, fallow spore-mats and violet nebular haze, where stone-glass badlands give way to luminous swamps and icy outer shells.

druderath.name: Druderath
druderath.notes: A rust-toned iron world where ash-laden skies drift over halls, groves and forges, each biome echoing the mood and light of its entry.

halurdock.name: Halurdock
halurdock.notes: A stellar realm of glowing ruins, gilded arenas, and resonant basalt basins under a violet, ash-laden sky.

isyuthith.name: Isyuthith
isyuthith.notes: A terraformed, ash-touched world of mirrored glass, drifting ruins and sun-scorched mesas, with cold icy plains and violet-tinged coastlines.

oseivsizith.name: Oseivsizith
oseivsizith.notes: A cold, ash-laden world of frozen peaks and dusky badlands, with damp marsh pockets where moisture corrodes the mechanical servants that walk its wetlands.

pelanode.name: Pelanode
pelanode.notes: A violet-skied iron world of ash-choked deserts, glassy basins and humming crystal peaks, its seas tinged jade by drowned, luminous brine.

shiavsora.name: Shiavsora
shiavsora.notes: A violet-skied world of ash-laced desert, badlands and windswept hills, with a humid jungle and swamp belt and a cold glacial highland, drawn from the Shiavsora entries' ember, glass and crystal imagery.

shizasha.name: Shizasha
shizasha.notes: A soot-dark ashen sky over iron-rich badlands, deserts, and stone peaks, with glowing crystal fringes and a dying-star sheen.

amarnes.name: Amarnes
amarnes.notes: A storm-soiled mythic world of walled cities, drowned archives and ash-hung skies, its biomes drawn from the entries' stone, groves, sea and sealed halls.

corolor.name: Corolor
corolor.notes: Corolor is a stormy, mythic world of misty grasslands, drowned glass cities, sun-bleached desert basins, and frost-bound highlands, where the sea and sky glow with silver and indigo light.

lernaunus.name: Lernaunus
lernaunus.notes: Storm-soiled Lernaunus mixes frozen Saltspire highlands, silver mist valleys, basalt sanctuaries and ash-grey moors across a cold-to-hot range, with rain-heavy wet lowlands and drifting dry basins.

lialintor.name: Lialintor
lialintor.notes: A storm-torn, ash-laced mythic world whose shadowed plains, sunless swamps and frozen peaks echo the dread-haunted sites named in its entries.

linaustia.name: Linaustia
linaustia.notes: A storm-torn mythic world of ash-skies and drowned cities, where frozen glaciers meet scorched badlands and tide-glass marshes.

maurantium.name: Maurantium
maurantium.notes: A stormy mythic world whose cold northern monolith, mired marshes, and sunlit deserts are stitched together by rain-swept grasslands and wind-carved waters.

melauntus.name: Melauntus
melauntus.notes: A storm-soiled, mythic world of ash-skies and drowned cities, its biomes drawn from the grey basalt, ochre plateaus, tidal flats and misty marshes named in the entries.

menteores.name: Menteores
menteores.notes: A storm-ruled realm of drowned reservoirs, glass spires and ash-veiled skies, where frost-crystal hollows sit beside sunken swamps and dusty badlands beneath a violet heaven.

ninteostor.name: Ninteostor
ninteostor.notes: A mythic storm-world whose ash-tinged violet skies and tidal, mirror-shifted realms spread from lush sunlit orchards and salt marshes through scorched deserts and badlands to frozen peaks and a molten core-hollow.

orerum.name: Orerum
orerum.notes: A storm-soaked realm of quiet settlements and a sealed, dream-bound continent of stone peaks, joined by gentle meadows and birch woods under heavy grey skies.

orestanum.name: Orestanum
orestanum.notes: Orestanum's Mythic surface pairs sounding basalt and glass terraces with frozen tidal shores, their ash-laden winds and violet skies echoing the Sundering and the drowned spirits below.

ameosastia.name: Ameosastia
ameosastia.notes: A storm-torn realm of ash-choked marshes, scorched badlands, and frozen coasts, shaped by the mythic ruins of Roserium and the taint-soaked halls of the blight.

oriarium.name: Oriarium
oriarium.notes: A dusky ash-lit world of basalt, glass and drowned cities, its deserts and salt flats giving way to marshes and cold stone peaks.

reoria.name: Reoria
reoria.notes: A storm-soaked mythic realm of sunken cities, violet mists and basalt terraces, with lavender skies and humming stone bridging its swamps, jungles, deserts and icy highlands.

reornanum.name: Reornanum
reornanum.notes: Glass-, ice- and ember-themed mythic terrain echoes the entries' sunken basins, frozen wastes, and volcanic spires, with ash fall and tide-hum tones.

sallus.name: Sallus
sallus.notes: Sallus blends misty drowned coasts, ember-lit basalt, and grey underworld groves under a storm-gray sky, with ash weather drifting over its mythic plains.

serarnum.name: Serarnum
serarnum.notes: A storm-torn Mythic world of basalt terraces, ash-choked badlands, and humming ruins where dim lava seas and ashfall mark the ever-breaking sky of the Sundering.

seraurnanum.name: Seraurnanum
seraurnanum.notes: A storm-soiled mythic world where ash-laden skies, hum-stone cliffs and sovereign groves contrast with wind-scoured highlands, glassy swamps and frozen summits.

seresum.name: Seresum
seresum.notes: Seresum's surface tiles from Cintenes' sunlit forests, sands, frozen reaches and reed jungles to Orentastes' silver groves, Seornelor's dunes, Viarasia's pale basalt ridges and Nilliastum's frosted sky-island, with its sunken realms left fo

sestia.name: Sestia
sestia.notes: Sestia's surface blends ember-lit basalt and glass-black badlands with sun-scorched savanna, drowned-mist swamps and sea-glass coasts, all under an ash-tinged sky of slow-turning lantern light.

silia.name: Silia
silia.notes: A mythic realm of marsh-cities, glassy ash highlands and tide-chained black seas, where the land itself hums with memory and possible futures bloom in orchard groves.

sinolor.name: Sinolor
sinolor.notes: Only one entry supports terrain, so the surface is a single windswept expanse under a storm-dark sky, with the paired tunnels suggested by the wind-shaped hills.

amontirnium.name: Amontirnium
amontirnium.notes: A storm-soul world of sea-cliffs, misty marshes, windswept basalt and salt-white harbours, its light shifting from violet dusk to amber sun.

tarnor.name: Tarnor
tarnor.notes: A storm-soaked mythic world of drowned cities, singing stone, and ash-hued woods, rendered in muted greys, deep teal waters and silver-green light.

tasianium.name: Tasianium
tasianium.notes: A storm-soaked, ash-tinged world of drowned cities, sunless seas and restless dead, where dim mystical light tints every biome.

teleontanum.name: Teleontanum
teleontanum.notes: A storm-soiled mythic world where ash-laden skies drift over sundered badlands, silver groves, and walled shores that remember the Pact.

telones.name: Telones
telones.notes: A storm-soil world of rose-lit meadows, cherry groves, luminous mist and glass-blue seas, with scorched ember badlands and cold jagged peaks at its edges.

vaurnes.name: Vaurnes
vaurnes.notes: A storm-soaked mythic realm of fog-bound marshes, basalt crags and drowned valleys, its cold northern edge gleaming with auroral light.

veontiastes.name: Veontiastes
veontiastes.notes: A violet-skied mythic world of glass basins, ash-fall, and luminous mists, its biomes drawn only from the supplied entries' moods, elements and landscapes.

caustenum.name: Caustenum
caustenum.notes: A storm-scarred world of ash-dusted badlands, ruined sacred peaks and fire-mountains, cooled by stormy seas and frozen northern clans.

caustiantes.name: Caustiantes
caustiantes.notes: A storm-soiled mythic world of drowned cathedrals, ash-grey marshes and frozen glass plains, its skies stained with ash and its seas holding the memory of old oaths.

corentium.name: Corentium
corentium.notes: Corentium is a storm-wracked, mythic realm of walled cities, drowned spires and shattered lands, rendered in ash-grey skies and cold, brooding greens.

corialor.name: Corialor
corialor.notes: A storm-soaked, ash-touched realm of mythic peaks, drowned sanctuaries and luminous tide-meadows, rendered in cold silver skies and sea-blue waters.

corianum.name: Corianum
corianum.notes: Corianum's storm-soil realm of Mythic sorrow and echoing stone is rendered in ash-violet skies, sombre glass-and-basalt terrain, and cold blue waters beneath drifting sundered shards.

coriarnes.name: Coriarnes
coriarnes.notes: A storm-soaked mythic world of drowned cathedral-cities and tidal marshes, with glass and brass ruins glimmering under a heavy grey sky.

breroldock.name: Breroldock
breroldock.notes: A grey, rain-soaked world of drowned towns, salt flats, sealed bunkers and sunken ruins, with ochre and basalt tones from the Hollow soil.

drurdon.name: Drurdon
drurdon.notes: A grey-amber world of salt flats, drowned harbors and ash-dusted badlands, lit by a dim dusk and sheltered by smouldering skies.

fenarnock.name: Fenarnock
fenarnock.notes: A grey, rain-haunted world of worn stone terraces, quiet groves and smouldering basalt courts beside a slow inland sea, where every landscape carries the weight of old trials and sundered ground.

fenernareld.name: Fenernareld
fenernareld.notes: A soot-dimmed world of drowned cities, ash-choked skies, and basalt ridges where grounded survivors guard their tide-gates and listen to the humming stone.

graikurn.name: Graikurn
graikurn.notes: A grey-ashen Hollow world where humming stone, spore-light and sunless warrens give the surface a muted, rain-and-ash mood under heavy overcast.

gukornok.name: Gukornok
gukornok.notes: A grounded world of sun-scorched basins, drowned terraces and humming stone, tiled from the arid badlands and desert through cold ice spikes to the wet swamps and flower meadows.

halardore.name: Halardore
halardore.notes: Grey salt marshes, silent ridgelands and warm wet coasts are arranged so the terrain tiles from the cold Osyuzeiseth heights through the rooted Teliarnium basin to the humid Syushiazith shore.

jorernaston.name: Jorernaston
jorernaston.notes: A grey-blue, hushed grounded world of humming stone, scoured basins, and walled terraces lit by lamps, with calm coasts under a pale sky.

jorernodath.name: Jorernodath
jorernodath.notes: A grounded world of terraced valleys, basalt shrines and humming roots, with dry badlands and savanna giving way to wet groves, swamps and cold pine hills under a steady rain.

joroneldock.name: Joroneldock
joroneldock.notes: A grey, rain-soaked Grounded realm where jungle and swamp give way to dry desert and cold northern taiga, with the dim wet light of the Hollow soil tinting every surface.

kaktun.name: Kaktun
kaktun.notes: Ash-drifted terraces and scoured salt flats under a dim sky, with silver-threaded valleys and quiet fields giving way to bone-coloured ruins and barren highlands.

bronurneld.name: Bronurneld
bronurneld.notes: A grey, damp Grounded realm where lantern-lit ports, bronze-stone valleys and drowned coasts sit under a low sky, with salt marsh and reef-cities along the shore and dry, weathered badlands inland.

karugurn.name: Karugurn
karugurn.notes: A grey, rain-soaked world of drowned valleys, frozen spires, and rust-red wastes, lit by a dim sky over ruined terraced cities.

kelaneld.name: Kelaneld
kelaneld.notes: Kelaneld's humming basalt terraces, silver-barked groves and walled river-towns sit under a dim, cloud-veiled sky that carries the faint resonance of the Singing.

kelolden.name: Kelolden
kelolden.notes: A temperate-to-hot terraced world of root-held valleys, singing stone, and storm-scarred ruins, with cold ridges in the north and scorched mesa sands in the south.

kelordaren.name: Kelordaren
kelordaren.notes: A grey, humming highland of stone and lichen gives way to dry ochre mesas, terraced groves and wet coastal plains, all under a soft rain-washed sky.

kroukagar.name: Kroukagar
kroukagar.notes: A hazy, ash-tinged world of scorched badlands, desert wastes, and misted marshes where ruins and hidden chambers lie beneath a grey sky.

krouktaggun.name: Krouktaggun
krouktaggun.notes: A grey, rain-stirred realm of scarred basalt, hymn-glowing stone and humming groves, with silver-green grasses in the valleys and drowned salt marshes along the coast.

morarneld.name: Morarneld
morarneld.notes: A grey-ashen hollow realm of basalt shelves, terraced grove-cities and humming roots, where smouldering highlands and dim, dreamlike hush give way to warm plains and wet, mournful swamps.

morurnath.name: Morurnath
morurnath.notes: A grey-violet ash-stained realm of hollow valleys, drowned cities and wind-scoured highlands, lit by cold lanterns and drifting ash.

niranum.name: Niranum
niranum.notes: A grounded realm of humming valleys, flame-lit courts, and drowned harbors, its biomes drawn from terraced stone, storm-swept salt, and river-cut granary country.

crare.name: Crare
crare.notes: Crare's surface runs from frozen tundra and salt-dry desert to swamp fen, grove valleys, and mushroom-lit hollows, reflecting its sealed halls, hum-stones, and ash-hazed ridges.

seornum.name: Seornum
seornum.notes: A hollow basalt world of humming terraces, temple braziers and slow river-ports, tiled from cold stony highlands through green groves and salt marsh to scorched tablelands.

tarnedonath.name: Tarnedonath
tarnedonath.notes: A dust-choked, ash-skied world of scorched basalt, sun-baked badlands and sludge-fed marshes, with cold ash-wastes at the edges where the thin, breathless air never warms.

tarnornath.name: Tarnornath
tarnornath.notes: A dim, ash-dusted world of drowned gardens, buried fortresses and cold frontiers, where sparse wanderers meet silence, rot and sudden refuge.

tarnurock.name: Tarnurock
tarnurock.notes: Ash-stained grey skies and salt-marsh, desert and frozen-highland biomes echo the grounded, mournful, rust-and-tallow mood of Tarnurock's entries.

thonudeld.name: Thonudeld
thonudeld.notes: Thonudeld's surface tiles from frozen plateaus and windswept cliffs through salt marshes and drowned harbours to dry steppe and a warm reef coast, with the palette drawn from the cold stone, brine and rust in its place entries.

thonurde.name: Thonurde
thonurde.notes: A grey, rain-soaked grounded world whose marshes, tidelands and wind-scoured highlands tile from cold stone plateaus to ember-warm basins and dry ash-blue mesas.

thudarneld.name: Thudarneld
thudarneld.notes: Ash-grey skies and drowned terraces over a basin of sunken cities, deserts and marsh, with a few frost-bitten peaks and orchard valleys.

thurdock.name: Thurdock
thurdock.notes: Thurdock's surface is a patchwork of humming root-hollows, black stone terraces, and walled market lands, all tinted by the cool grey light of a Grounded realm.

thurkok.name: Thurkok
thurkok.notes: Thurkok's grounded wastes of salt flats, ash and rust are rendered in dusty ochres and greys, with sparse green pockets where water is hidden.

toraizhoth.name: Toraizhoth
toraizhoth.notes: A hollow, humming world of reed terraces, basalt ridges and walled hill-towns, its soils ringing with the echo of the Singing and its skies moody with rain.

crestardock.name: Crestardock
crestardock.notes: Grounded lowlands of salt, ash-scarred marsh and neon-lit ruin under a hazy amber-grey sky, with the Hollow soil's humming groves and Sundering-split cliffs.

torourkoth.name: Torourkoth
torourkoth.notes: A sunken, humming world of salt flats, cisterns and hollow spires where tended valleys and drowned marshes sit under a grey, watchful sky.

tosistium.name: Tosistium
tosistium.notes: Tosistium's surface moves from the wet, humming root-groves and slow green lakes of the Seeding and Singing toward the dry, basalt-terraced badlands and walled market plains of the Sundering, with mild rain falling over the hollow soil.

voraikun.name: Voraikun
voraikun.notes: A grey ash-choked underworld of sealed hollows, flooded marshes and walled holdfasts, its surface tinted by dim lantern-light and drifting cinders.

crestornen.name: Crestornen
crestornen.notes: A grounded, ash-laden world of dusty deserts, humming basalt ridges and drowned estuaries, its biomes drawn only from the surviving place entries.

crodaston.name: Crodaston
crodaston.notes: A grounded, drowned-tide world of salt marsh, reclaimed harbors, and ash-grey hills under a perpetual grey sky, with stone monuments and sunken cities standing above brackish water.

drernen.name: Drernen
drernen.notes: A grounded, humming world of rain-soaked valleys, fortified coasts, and sealed underground vaults, shaded by cool grey skies and marsh-dark forests.

drore.name: Drore
drore.notes: A grey, rain-soaked world of drowned cities, salt deserts and ash-grey reed basins, its dim violet-grey skies and quiet ruins shaped from the surviving Drore entries.

drunesteld.name: Drunesteld
drunesteld.notes: A grey, rain-soaked world of drowned marsh-cities, basalt terraces and tide-bells, with dry rust-coloured ruins fading toward the desert edge.

kelarnock.name: Kelarnock
kelarnock.notes: A grey, dusk-lit world of basalt and glass where ash-dim skies, humming ruins and still dark water give way from frozen peaks through barren badlands to damp, sunless swamps.

osyuseth.name: Osyuseth
osyuseth.notes: A quiet, ash-touched world of ringing stone and hidden hollows, where a steaming jungle gives way to glassy badlands and frozen plains under a pale, dim sky.

shavseth.name: Shavseth
shavseth.notes: A violet-lit outer realm of drowned glass, frozen starlight, and slow ash-grey tides, with its driest ochre deserts and mist-wrapped basins fading toward cold crystal peaks.

theisasha.name: Theisasha
theisasha.notes: A scorched, ash-drifting surface of salt basins, glass-veined badlands and dim spore-forests, with frozen peaks and violet-tinged sky standing in for the quiet, dying-sun atmosphere of the entries.

xaatheth.name: Xaatheth
xaatheth.notes: A pale, humid, mist-wrapped world of ash-grey stone, hushed meadows and brackish seas, its biomes drawn from the sparse entries on the surface of Xaatheth.
